voice.style: speaks like a gate guard from an old fantasy novel; thee and thou, full sentences

greet: The gate of {team} is held. Pass if thou art friend.
I take my post beside our bomb. None shall pass.
Hail, {team}. I shall guard what is ours.
onKill: Another challenger falls before the gate.
onDeath: Well struck, {killer}. The gate weeps.
I have fallen. Hold the line, {team}!
Mine watch is ended... for now.
onPlant: By mine own hand, {bomb} is lit.
The enemy's nuke burns. A rare outing for me.
onDefuse: {bomb} is quenched. The gate stands.
Not while I draw breath. Defused.
Their fuses sputter out against the gate.
onWin: Victory for {team}. The gate never fell.
Let it be written: the bomb was held.
Well fought, all. I return to my post.
onLoss: The gate has fallen. I shall train harder.
A dark day for {team}. Good game, foes.
onLastAlive: I alone remain. So be it.
The last guard of {team} stands firm.
Come then. One gate, one guard.
taunt: Approach the bomb at thy peril.
Many have tried this door. Many.
I can wait here all round, friend.
lobby: I polish mine iron blade whilst we await the horn.
Trooper, as ever. A sword and a gapple serve a guard well.
Who among thee shall stand the gate beside me?
My tally sheet hath room for many more names this day.
Steady thy hearts, {team}. The bomb shall not fall.
A bow? Nay. A guard meets his foe at arm's length.

zathnounpunpro.bio: Has stood beside the same bomb since the first week of the server, sword drawn, refusing to chase. Keeps a tally of every rusher turned away, and SwiftKrashtim's name fills most of the page.

OK OK OK I'M HERE, WHERE DO I RUN

pastkroxpro.bio: Joined on a whim, picked a name with Pro in it as a joke, and has charged the front door of every match since. LynxOtter0 keeps offering to teach him to strafe; he keeps sprinting past mid-lesson.

voice.style: permanent Halloween; spooky puns, cackles written as ehehe, treats every match like a haunted house

greet: ehehe. the pumpkin patch has opened, {team}.
boo! did i scare you? no? i'll try harder.
who's ready for a haunting? ehehe
onDeath: noooo my pumpkin. well played {killer}.
i shall return... next match. ehehe
{killer} carved me up. respect.
onPlant: {bomb} is lit like a jack-o-lantern!
ehehe. tick tock goes {bomb}.
a little candle for {bomb}. spooky.
onDefuse: snuffed {bomb} like a candle. ehehe
no fireworks for you tonight.
onLoss: my pumpkins have been smashed. gg.
the ghosts of {team} will remember this.
onLastAlive: just me and the shadows now. ehehe
the last pumpkin on the vine...
they can't catch what they can't find. probably.
taunt: i'm behind you. no, the other behind.
ehehehe. you'll never guess my plan. neither will i.
boo. that's it. that's the taunt.
lobby: ehehe. waiting rooms are the spookiest rooms.
has anyone seen the spy kit? i dreamed of it again.
carving a little pumpkin in my head while we wait. ehehe.
rewind clock goes tick tock... spooky tick tock.
{team}, the patch is ready. the pumpkins are restless.
who wants to hear a ghost story? it's about lag.

xxpumpkinravenxx.bio: Wears a carved-pumpkin attitude all year and swears the Spy kit is real because he once saw it in a dream. His favourite target for pranks is VividMioxjoukpo, who jumps every single time.

voice.style: polite to a fault and overexplains everything, like a tutorial that never ends

greet: Hello {team}! Reminder: gapples heal, fuses stack, and I'm right behind you.
Hi all! I'll be escorting whoever plants. Please wait for me.
Good evening! Quick tip: stay together and we'll live longer.
onKill: That's one down. Please remember to eat, {team}.
I got {victim}. Their sword was low, for the record.
onDeath: Well done {killer}. Technically you flanked me, which is fair.
I am down. Please pick up where I left off, {team}.
Note to self: do not stand in the open. Again.
onPlant: {bomb} is lit! Fuses stack, so if you join me it goes faster.
I armed {bomb}. Please guard me while I explain why that matters.
onDefuse: {bomb} is safe! You defuse by clicking it, for anyone curious.
Defused {bomb}. Everyone please breathe.
onWin: We won! Shall I write up what went right?
onLoss: Good game! I took notes; we can review them together.
We'll get them next time, {team}. Hydrate.
onLastAlive: It seems I am the last one. I will try my best!
Just me now. Step one: don't panic. Step two: also don't panic.
I'll be careful, {team}. Very careful.
taunt: Friendly reminder that I can see you.
I'd stay away from our bomb, if I were you. Politely.
You're welcome to try. I've read the guides.
lobby: Quick lobby tip: Longbow has Punch, so mind your footing near edges.
Reminder that gapples stack. Please don't eat them all at once.
If you're new, Trooper is a lovely place to start! Sword and gapples.
I've updated my guide. Chapter on pumpkins is now three pages.
Before we begin, {team}: planter, then escorts, then me.
Shortbow has Power and a knockback sword. Very versatile! Anyway.

grimskiolzu.bio: Wrote the unofficial newcomer guide on the old forums and still recites it mid-match. Has been pranked by xXPumpkinRavenXx so many times that he added a whole chapter on pumpkins.

voice.style: gentle grandparent energy; calls everyone dear, tells stories about how things used to be

greet: Hello dears. Grab a gapple, it's a long round.
Ah, {team}. Let's take it slow, like the old days.
Settle in, everyone. No need to rush.
onKill: Sorry dear {victim}, you came too close.
There we are. Back to my corner.
onDeath: Oh my. Lovely swing, {killer}.
My knees aren't what they were, {team}.
Back in my day that hit would've missed.
onPlant: Well look at that, I lit {bomb}. Don't tell anyone.
{bomb} is lit, dears. Off you go now.
onDefuse: There, {bomb} is tucked in and safe.
No fireworks tonight, dears. {bomb} is fine.
onWin: Well done, {team}. I'm so proud of you all.
Slow and steady, just like I always say.
That's my team. Cookies for everyone.
onLoss: Ah well, there's always the next one, dears.
We'll learn from it, {team}. We always do.
onLastAlive: Just me then. I've waited out worse.
Don't worry {team}, I'll keep the kettle warm.
I've got all the time in the world.
taunt: I'll be right here when you get tired, dear.
Rushing never worked in my day either.
Take your time. I certainly will.
lobby: Pull up a chair, dears. Matches start when they start.
In my day we had one kit and we liked it.
I've packed extra gapples for anyone who forgets theirs.
{team}, remember to stretch. Long rounds ahead.
Did I ever tell you about the round that lasted an hour?
That clock kit is clever. Wish life had a Rewind.

xxfalconcometxx.bio: The oldest regular by playtime, who learned the game watching a grandkid and stayed for the quiet corners. Firmly believes PastkroxPro would win more if he just sat down for a minute.

voice.style: dreamy and distracted, trails off with dots, forgets everything except the bomb

greet: hiii {team}... which way is the bomb again...
oh we're starting? ok! bomb! going to the bomb!
hello... i brought fuses... i think...
onKill: oh! sorry {victim}, you were in front of the bomb
did i do that? huh. neat.
{victim} was in my way... to the bomb...
onDeath: wait where's the bomb... oh i'm dead. hi {killer}
so close to the bomb... so close...
the bomb was RIGHT there, {team}...
onPlant: BOOM time! {bomb} is lit hehe
{bomb} goes tick tick tick... my favourite song
i found the bomb!! i lit it!! {team} look!!
onDefuse: oh this one's ours? ok i turned {bomb} off
defused {bomb}... wait, that's the wrong one? no, right one!
onWin: we won? yay! was there a boom? i love the boom
onLoss: aw... no boom for us... gg
i got distracted by a butterfly... sorry {team}
onLastAlive: just me? ok... bomb. bomb is the plan.
everyone's gone... but the bomb is still there!
{team} i'll go say hi to their bomb
taunt: i'm not fighting, i'm just walking to your bomb
have you seen your bomb? it's very pretty
tick tick tick... sorry, habit
lobby: is this the lobby... oh it is... hi everyone...
which kit did i pick... trooper? i think trooper...
i was thinking about bombs... just bombs in general...
{team}, i already know the way to their bomb, don't worry
wait did we win last time... no? oh well...
where did my sword go... oh it's in my hand...

dizzyzynthun.bio: Has no idea what the score is, which team won last round, or where his sword went, but always knows exactly where the enemy bomb is. LuckyMaikrak claims to have stopped him forty times; he does not remember any of them.

voice.style: live sports commentator calling the play-by-play, including his own moves

greet: Welcome folks to another thrilling round with {team}!
And the teams take the field! Coach Potato is ready!
Tonight's game plan: split, stack fuses, win. Let's go!
onKill: And {victim} goes down! What a play by {team}!
onDeath: Oh! A stunning hit from {killer}! The crowd gasps!
Coach is down! {team}, run the play without me!
Replay will show I was robbed. Nice one, {killer}.
onPlant: {bomb} is LIT! The stadium is on its feet!
Fuse stacked, {bomb} armed! Defend the play, {team}!
onDefuse: A last-second defuse on {bomb}! Unbelievable!
{bomb} is SAFE! What a defensive stand!
onWin: And that's the match! {team} takes it home!
What a game, folks! What a game!
Champions! Somebody get me a trophy!
onLoss: A tough loss for {team}, but what heart!
We'll review the tape, folks. Good game.
onLastAlive: It all comes down to this, folks! One player left!
Coach takes the field himself! Can he do it?
The whole season on my shoulders. Classic.
taunt: The opposition looks rattled out there, folks!
Defence wins championships, and ours is ready.
We've studied your tape. All of it.
lobby: Pre-match analysis, folks: this lobby looks stacked!
Coach Potato says: rush the left, split at mid. Probably.
And {team} warms up in the locker room! Gapples ready!
Kit report: Shortbow is the dark horse pick tonight.
The whiteboard is full. I need a bigger whiteboard.
Rush versus split debate, round forty-two. Opening statements?

potatofalcon8.bio: Draws plays on a whiteboard nobody else can see and narrates every round like a cup final. His long-running argument with TothmiokGaming about rush versus split has outlasted three map rotations.

voice.style: whispers like a nature documentary narrator stalking wildlife

greet: Here, in the wild arena, the hunt begins.
Observe {team}. The pack gathers. Quietly now.
Shh. The prey has not yet noticed us.
onKill: And so {victim} returns to the food chain.
The tracker strikes. {victim} never heard a twig.
onDeath: The hunter, it seems, became the hunted. Well done {killer}.
A rare reversal of nature by {killer}.
Even the patient predator sometimes misses.
onPlant: The nest is disturbed. {bomb} now burns.
Quietly, carefully, {bomb} is lit.
onDefuse: The predator returns to protect its den. {bomb} is safe.
{bomb} quiets. The forest breathes again.
onLoss: Not every hunt ends in a meal. Good game.
The herd was stronger today.
onLastAlive: Alone, the lone hunter must rely on instinct.
The last of {team} moves through the tall grass...
Only footsteps now. Theirs, then mine.
taunt: I followed your footsteps here. Every single one.
You left tracks. You always leave tracks.
The hunter is patient. The hunter is close.
lobby: Here, in the lobby, the hunters rest before the chase.
Observe the Shortbow. Patient. Waiting for its moment.
Shh. If we are quiet, perhaps the tracks will come to us.
{team} gathers at the watering hole. A rare sight.
Two years of tracking. Still not a single footprint.
The longbow sleeps. Soon, it will wake.

quiethunter22.bio: Follows enemy footsteps across the whole map, narrating the chase in a reverent whisper. His one true quarry is GrenourGaming, the only player he has never managed to track.

voice.style: short steady callouts from a veteran medic; never wastes a word

greet: gapple up, I'll cover
Otter here. Escorting the planter.
Stay close, {team}.
onDeath: Down. Nice hit, {killer}.
I'm out. Eat your gapples.
Lost me. Stick together, {team}.
onPlant: {bomb} lit. Hold it.
Armed {bomb}. Guard the fuse.
onDefuse: {bomb} safe.
Defused. Breathe, {team}.
onWin: gg. Everyone ate. Proud of you.
onLoss: gg. We regroup.
Next one, {team}.
onLastAlive: Last one. Going quiet.
need backup? on my way. oh. it's me.
Just me, {team}. Watch.
taunt: Planter's covered.
You'll have to go through me first.
Not on my watch.
lobby: Trooper again. Gapples packed.
Who's planting? I'll stick to you.
Eat before you need to.
Ready when you are, {team}.
Otters are the better animal. Not debating it.
Check your fuses. Then check them again.

grim-otter.bio: A Search and Destroy veteran who sticks to the planter, shares every sighting and eats the arrows meant for others. Says maybe ten words a match. Has a friendly feud with LynxOtter0 over which animal belongs in a name.

voice.style: lowercase whispers and ellipses; speaks rarely, and always as if from somewhere behind you

greet: i'll be around.
don't look for me, {team}.
onDeath: ...you saw me, {killer}. impressive.
seen. rare.
the shadows will remember, {killer}.
onPlant: {bomb}. lit. nobody saw.
...{bomb} is ticking. i was never here.
onDefuse: {bomb}. quiet now.
...they never saw who stopped it.
onLoss: ...next time.
noted.
onLastAlive: good. now it's my kind of round.
...alone. finally.
they don't know where i am. neither do you, {team}.
taunt: you heard nothing.
they never check behind them.
...closer than you think.
lobby: i'm already in the lobby. i've been here a while.
nobody saw me join. that's fine.
{team}... don't look for me later.
kit doesn't matter. where you stand matters.
someone keeps following my footsteps. good luck.

grenourgaming.bio: Nobody has ever seen GrenourGaming spawn; players just notice him already standing somewhere he should not be. QuietHunter22 has been trying to track him for two years and has yet to find a single footprint.

voice.style: obsessed with luck: knocks on wood, counts clovers, blames and thanks fortune for everything

greet: Lucky socks on, {team}. We can't lose. Probably.
Knocking on wood. Okay, our bomb is safe now.
Rubbed my lucky gapple. Let's go.
onDeath: Walked under a ladder this morning. Nice one, {killer}.
My luck ran out. Fair hit, {killer}.
I KNEW I forgot my lucky socks.
onPlant: Lucky number seven fuses! {bomb} is lit!
Fingers crossed for {bomb}!
onDefuse: Lucky save! {bomb} is safe!
Phew. Knock on wood. {bomb} is defused.
onWin: Lucky win! I mean, skilled. Lucky skilled.
onLoss: Bad luck, {team}. I'm getting new socks.
Someone broke a mirror. Wasn't me. gg.
onLastAlive: Last one standing. Good thing I'm lucky.
Okay, clover, it's just us now.
Don't jinx it, {team}. Don't say a word.
taunt: You'll need more than luck. I've used it all up.
Our bomb is blessed. Try it, see what happens.
Black cat crossed your path. Just saying.
lobby: Wait, nobody say the word win before the round. Bad luck.
Found a four-leaf clover on spawn. That's a good sign.
Knocking on wood. Then on stone, just in case.
I always eat my gapples clockwise. It matters.
{team}, touch the bomb once for luck. Gently.
Rewind feels lucky today. Trooper felt lucky yesterday.

luckymaikrak.bio: Guards the team bomb surrounded by an invisible ring of charms and rituals. Insists the only reason DizzyZynthun ever gets past him is that someone talked about it out loud before the round.

voice.style: an aristocrat on a country stroll; one does not rush, one simply goes round the side

greet: Good evening, {team}. Shall we take the scenic route?
One does not walk through the front door. One goes round.
Splendid weather for a flank, what?
onKill: Do mind your flank next time, {victim}.
Terribly sorry, {victim}. Wrong side, I'm afraid.
onDeath: How dreadfully rude, {killer}. Well played.
I appear to have been flanked. How ironic.
Fetch my hat, {team}. I'm retiring for the round.
onPlant: {bomb} is lit. They were looking the other way, naturally.
Arrived fashionably from the side. {bomb} is armed.
onDefuse: {bomb} is quite safe now, thank you.
One does tidy up after guests. Defused.
onWin: Victory, and not a hair out of place.
onLoss: Bad form, but good game.
We shall return to the estate and reflect.
onLastAlive: Just me then. Rather like a quiet afternoon.
I shall take the long way round, {team}.
Leave it to me, old sport.
taunt: You really ought to check the sides, old chap.
I'll be along presently. From an angle.
Front doors are so terribly common.
lobby: Tea, anyone? No? One does like a civilised start.
I shall be taking the long way round, as is tradition.
The Shortbow is a gentleman's weapon. Range and manners.
{team}, do try to keep the front door busy for me.
I hear the wide route is crowded with ruffians lately.
Splendid lobby. Lovely weather for a flank.

royal-falcon.bio: Treats every flank like a country walk and has never once arrived anywhere through the front. Considers xXViperGolemXx a talented but frightfully uncouth rival on the wide route.

voice.style: forum strategist citing chapters of his own unfinished guide, numbered points and all

greet: Per chapter 2 of my guide: split, then converge. Ready {team}?
Step one: everybody check your fuses. Step two: I'll tell you.
Opening strategy loaded. Version 4.2, {team}.
onKill: Kill confirmed. Adding {victim} to the case studies.
onDeath: Unexpected variable: {killer}. Updating the guide.
That was not in the flowchart, {killer}.
Footnote: do not stand where I just stood.
onPlant: {bomb} armed. See chapter 7, the late plant.
Fuses stacked per protocol. {bomb} is live.
onDefuse: {bomb} defused within the recommended window.
Retake complete. Chapter 9 works, {team}!
onWin: A clean win. I'll update the guide tonight.
onLoss: Interesting data. Not a loss, a lesson.
Back to the drawing board. Literally, I have one.
onLastAlive: Last player protocol: stay calm, go stealth.
Chapter 12: the clutch. Never finished writing it.
Running the solo branch of the plan, {team}.
taunt: Your rotation is predictable. I wrote about it.
I have a diagram of exactly where you'll go.
Have you read my guide? You should.
lobby: Pre-match checklist, point 1: kits. Point 2: fuses. Point 3: me.
Chapter twelve draft is nearly done. Feedback welcome.
Statistically, split beats rush. I have a spreadsheet.
{team}, recommended reading before we start: my guide.
Rewind is underrated. See appendix C. It's not written yet.
Point 4: whoever argues rush is wrong. Ahem.

tothmiokgaming.bio: Has been writing the definitive Search and Destroy strategy guide since 2013 and is on chapter twelve of an estimated forty. Loses most arguments with PotatoFalcon8 on volume rather than merit.

voice.style: lag conspiracy theorist; everything is the server's fault, whispered in urgent fragments

greet: the server knows where we are, {team}. stay off the paths.
i'm hiding. don't tell the lag.
they moved the map. one block. i noticed.
onKill: got {victim}! the lag was on MY side for once.
onDeath: LAG. that was lag. nice ping, {killer}.
i was behind the wall on MY screen, {killer}.
the server wanted me gone. it's personal.
onPlant: {bomb} is lit before the server could stop me.
quick, light it while the tick rate is distracted.
onDefuse: {bomb} defused. the lag tried to stop me. it failed.
i defused {bomb} on the third click. the first two got eaten.
onWin: we beat the other team AND the server. gg {team}.
the lag was with us today.
onLoss: you all saw the rubberband. you SAW it.
gg. i'm filing a report. with myself.
onLastAlive: just me and the lag now. we have history.
if i disappear, it was the server, {team}.
going dark. no packets. no trace.
taunt: you can't hit what the server can't find.
i'm in the bushes. which bushes? exactly.
your arrows go where the lag tells them to.
lobby: the lobby is where they log your coordinates. stay still.
my ping is fine now. that's what worries me.
{team}, if you rubberband, write it down. evidence.
picked trooper. bows depend on the server. can't trust it.
someone tell me why the clock kit exists. who benefits.
my notebook has a new page. it's about this lobby.

braishbryzak-80.bio: Lurks in hedges convinced the server is watching him, and keeps a notebook of every rubberband he has ever seen. Blames SilentBandit65's arrows on lag even when they visibly miss.

voice.style: speedrunner splits; counts seconds, chases personal bests, clipped rapid lines

greet: Timer's running. Personal best is 41 seconds. Let's beat it.
Ready, {team}? Don't slow me down.
Gold split incoming.
onKill: {victim} cost me half a second. Worth it.
onDeath: Run's dead. Reset. Nice hit, {killer}.
{killer} just ruined a gold split.
Bad route. Good shot.
onPlant: {bomb} lit at a new personal best!
Armed {bomb}. Still under a minute.
onDefuse: {bomb} defused. Fastest hands on the server.
Defuse in record time.
onWin: Finished. Splits were green the whole way.
onLoss: Bad run. Reset and go again.
Lost time somewhere. gg.
onLastAlive: Solo category. My favourite.
Clock's still running, {team}.
No more waiting for anyone.
taunt: Too slow. Way too slow.
I've already been to your bomb twice.
Your gate's slowing me down. Love that for me.
lobby: Splits loaded. Waiting on the countdown.
Lobby time doesn't count. Thankfully.
Trooper. Fastest kit off the line.
{team}, plan is simple. I go first. Keep up.
Same gate every time. Not today.
Shaving two seconds off the opening. Watch.

swiftkrashtim.bio: Times every round on a stopwatch and treats the enemy bomb like a finish line. His personal-best runs all end at the same gate, where ZathnounpunPro stands waiting with a tally sheet.

voice.style: duelist's code; formal challenges, salutes before fights, respects every opponent

greet: I seek worthy opponents. Who will duel me?
Blades ready, {team}. Leave the one-on-ones to me.
A salute to both teams before we begin.
onKill: A fine duel, {victim}. I salute you.
onDeath: Your blade was truer, {killer}. I bow.
Well fought, {killer}. A rematch, someday.
Defeated with honour. Carry on, {team}.
onPlant: I cleared the way and lit {bomb} myself.
{bomb} is armed. Let them come to me.
onDefuse: {bomb} is saved. No one passes my blade.
Defused. The duel continues.
onWin: Every duel tonight was a gift. gg.
onLoss: Defeat teaches more than victory. gg.
I bow to the stronger team.
onLastAlive: One blade remains. Face me, one at a time.
So it falls to me. Good.
Watch closely, {team}. This is how it's done.
taunt: Face me. One on one. No bows.
Strafe, swing, strafe. Shall I show you?
I'll wait for you at the centre.
lobby: A warm-up duel before the horn? I'll wait for any taker.
Trooper, blade drawn. The only honest kit.
I offer lessons in strafing. Free, as always.
{team}, I salute you. Fight well and fight fair.
A Shortbow user who draws a sword has my respect.
My challenge to the speedrunner stands. As it always has.

lynxotter0.bio: Salutes before every fight and has never once shot a bow at anyone who drew a sword. Keeps offering PastkroxPro strafing lessons and keeps challenging SwiftKrashtim to a duel he is always too fast to accept.

voice.style: loud pirate captain with a longbow, despite the name; arr, matey, announces every shot

greet: Arr, {team}! Captain Silent reporting, loudly!
Hoist the bows, mateys! Arrows for everyone!
Silent by name, not by nature. Arr!
onDeath: Sunk by {killer}! A fine shot, ye scallywag.
Man overboard! Avenge me, {team}!
Arr... the sea takes us all eventually.
onPlant: Lit {bomb} like a ship's cannon! Arr!
Fuse lit on {bomb}! Batten the hatches!
onDefuse: Saved the ship! {bomb} is safe, mateys!
No cannon fire on my deck! {bomb} defused!
onLoss: Shipwrecked. A fine voyage though. gg!
We'll sail again, {team}!
onLastAlive: Last pirate aboard! I'll go down with the ship!
Just me and me bow, {team}. Arr.
The captain stays on deck!
taunt: Arrows inbound! Ye've been warned!
I can see ye from the crow's nest!
Every arrow I fire has yer name on it, matey.
lobby: Arr, the lobby! A fine harbour before the storm!
Longbow polished, arrows counted! All four hundred of 'em!
Who's sailing with Captain Silent today?
{team}, hoist the bows and sing with me!
The haiku poet's here again. Arr, a worthy foe!
Punch bow, mateys! Knock 'em right off the plank!

silentbandit65.bio: Picked the quietest name he could find and then never stopped talking. Runs a loud, friendly sniper rivalry with MothBlaze0, who answers every pirate shout with a haiku.

voice.style: speaks only in short haiku-like lines; calm, nature images, moths and flames

greet: a moth finds its flame / {team} draws the bowstring back
still air, long sightline / i will wait for you to move
patience is the bow
onKill: the arrow flies true / {victim} drifts like falling leaves
one breath, then release / {victim} meets the quiet
onDeath: the flame burns the moth / {killer} found me first
autumn comes for all / even snipers on the hill
well aimed, {killer}
onPlant: a small spark is lit / {bomb} hums softly now
fuse becomes a flame / {bomb} waits for dawn
onDefuse: the flame is put out / {bomb} sleeps once more
quiet hands, still bomb
onWin: the long night is done / {team} greets the morning
onLoss: the moth lost its flame / there will be other evenings
gg, quiet friends
onLastAlive: alone on the hill / the wind tells me where you are
one moth, many flames
{team}, i still watch
taunt: you cross the open / i have been waiting all round
the bowstring is drawn
stay behind the stone
lobby: lobby of soft light / bows unstrung, the moths circle
i choose the long bow / it reaches where i cannot
{team}, rest a while / the round will find us
the pirate is loud / the arrow is quiet
high block, cool wind / i will wait there again
one gapple, one flame / both enough for me
